method.capture: DSP core only; offline rendering, not device latency or browser AudioWorklet timing
method.benchmark: Independent shifted voices; 40-second history primed untimed; 128 warmup blocks then 3 × 64 measured blocks
method.source: Deterministic harmonic tones, chirp, seeded-noise transients; input becomes silent at 1.8 s
method.nativeMemory: 40-second mono float32 history is 7,680,000 bytes, independent of voice count, plus fixed voice state
method.browserMemory: Granular economy also shares raw history; Silky spectral bank needs one 40-second history per lane plus raw unison (3–16 shifted lanes)

javascript.repetitionPolicy: Fresh engine, identical primed history, identical warmup and input block sequence for each repetition

rust.memoryMeasurement: History, window, reserved voice structs and installed key capacities; excludes allocator overhead, control-thread temporary maps, source/render buffers and CPAL/ring buffers.
rust.method: Each repetition uses a fresh engine and identical periodic-source history prefill with voices disabled; voice warmup and source preparation are untimed. Process_block (including internal finish_block) timed for stationary 128-frame blocks. Offline CPU measurement; no device underrun guarantee.
